mapper.select: SELECT M.BIG_ROLL_CODE, GROUP_CONCAT(M.MACHINE_ID ORDER BY M.MACHINE_ID SEPARATOR ',') MACHINE_ID FROM T_GDYY_SPECIFY_MACHINE M LEFT JOIN T_GDYY_MACHINE_INFO MI ON MI.ID = M.MACHINE_ID WHERE M.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND MI.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND MI.STATUS = '0' AND M.JOB_TYPE = #{jobType} GROUP BY M.BIG_ROLL_CODE
